headline: Approved $157,500 website contract extension and a lease for 6,000 student Chromebooks and 1,000 staff MacBook Airs.
summary: Closed-door talks covered contract negotiations with several Educational Association of Worcester units. Students asked for bathroom repairs at Sullivan Middle School, and that request was sent to the Operations and Governance committee. A request to remove individual student devices from Pre-K through 2nd grade classrooms was sent to the TLSS committee.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda, including meeting minutes and donations, 9-0.
Referred the Sullivan Middle School bathroom petition to Operations and Governance, 9-0.
Accepted Finance Committee actions on FY26 and FY27 budget reports, 9-0.
Held the district boundary realignment report for future updates, 2-0.
Accepted Operations and Governance Committee actions, 9-0.
Accepted Teaching, Learning and Student Success Committee actions, 9-0.
Approved DESE grants and prior-year payments, including $175,000 and $112,501.93, 9-0.
Approved and filed the report on students leaving the district, 9-0.
Approved and filed the report on approved applications and Chromebook access, 9-0.
Approved the Future Ready Technology Committee report and held the item for future reports, 9-0.
Approved and filed reports on Chromebook classroom use and device usage, 9-0.
Referred the request to remove individual student devices from Pre-K through 2nd grade classrooms to TLSS, 9-0.
Approved a contract for an employee’s U.S. work visa, with up to $8,000 for legal and filing fees, 9-0.
Approved a three-year extension of the Apptegy website contract at $157,500, 9-0.
Approved a lease of up to five years to replace 1,000 staff MacBook Airs and 6,000 student Chromebooks, 9-0.
Approved releasing executive session minutes from 2023, 2024, and some of 2025, 9-0.
Approved a three-year renewal with CDW Government, LLC, for Lightspeed web filtering, 9-0.
